correctness.rationale: PASS. For all nonzero 15-bit ternary quartic equations over F2, geometric smoothness follows exactly from full rank of S6 + (S7)^3 -> S10 (dimension 66). The base-point-free degree-four system admits three generic quartic generators forming a length-three regular sequence; its quotient socle degree is 9, so degree-ten surjectivity is equivalent to having no geometric common zero. The derivative of a binary quartic restriction in characteristic 2 gives precisely the three coefficient cases for square-freeness on each of seven F2 rational lines. An independently implemented integer-bit elimination exhausted 32767 masks: 10920 geometrically smooth, t=0..7 histogram [25,168,588,2604,3885,2940,686,24], the stated 20 nonzero joint (rational-point, transverse-line) cells and 78 GL3(F2) orbits; transverse-free orbit sizes 1 and 24 with masks 21945 and 6670. Original bundled verify_quartic_spectrum.py and secondary Groebner source were inspected, but finite enumerations rely crucially on the rank equivalence, not finite-extension sampling. Scope: embedded equations/projective classes over F2, not abstract genus-three moduli or other fields.
